name: Women's Society of Cyberjutsu
notes: Affinity: women; org: Women's Society of Cyberjutsu (WSC); join: free-signup; scope: security. Official Slack join page linked from womenscyberjutsu.org (found via search result titled 'slack, cyberjutsu, women in cyber'). WebFetch got HTTP 403 on the page itself so exact signup mechanics (free vs. membership-gated) could not be fully verified from content; the URL is the org's own dedicated join-Slack page.

name: hackHER Network
notes: Affinity: women; org: Bugcrowd; join: request-form; scope: security. Women-only hacking/bug-bounty community run by Bugcrowd. Join by filling out the eligibility form; approved applicants are then emailed an invite to the dedicated hackHER Network Discord channel (not an instant-join Discord link).

name: WICCA (Women in Cybersecurity Community Association)
notes: Affinity: women; org: WICCA; join: open-link; scope: security. Official Discord invite found on womenofwicca.nl footer. 1,000+ member community founded 2018 in Amsterdam; Irish chapter WICCA IE exists via Meetup (no separate Discord found).

name: Haecksen (CCC)
notes: Affinity: women, lgbtq; org: Haecksen; join: request-form; scope: security. Primary chat is RocketChat, not Discord/Slack/Matrix. Requires requesting SSO credentials from admin@haecksen.org and joining their mailing list first — not a pure self-service invite link.

name: AWSN (Australian Women in Security Network)
notes: Affinity: women; org: AWSN; join: free-signup; scope: security. Free membership signup grants access to the AWSN Slack workspace (awsn-group.slack.com); membership application takes a few days to process, not an instant open invite link.

name: InfosecGirls
notes: Affinity: women; org: InfosecGirls; join: free-signup; scope: security. Community for women/students in infosec, founded 2014. Uses a Google Group as its public forum; no Discord/Slack found on official site.

name: Raíces Cyber
notes: Affinity: other; org: Raíces Cyber Org; join: open-link; scope: security. Largest nonprofit for Hispanic/Latino/Latinx people entering or working in cybersecurity; Discord is described as their community home base (2,500+ members). Discord invite link was found via search results describing their own site/bio.link, not directly loaded (bot-check blocked direct Discord fetch), so confidence is 'listing' rather than 'official'.

name: ColorStack
notes: Affinity: bipoc; org: ColorStack; join: free-signup; scope: tech-with-security-channel. Community for Black and Latinx computer science students (3,000+ members). Their Slack has a dedicated #career-cybersecurity channel per the community wiki. Join link is a Slack share-invite found via search; could not confirm it on colorstack.org directly (site did not surface a direct signup URL to WebFetch).

name: Cyversity
notes: Affinity: bipoc, women, other; org: Cyversity (formerly ICMCP); join: paid-membership; scope: security. Paid-membership community platform (not Discord/Slack/forum, but a self-service signup site anyone can pay to join). Pricing: $100/year for professionals, $20/year for students and veterans. No public Discord/Slack/forum found on the official site.

name: Minorities in Cybersecurity (MiC)
notes: Affinity: bipoc, women; org: Minorities in Cybersecurity; join: paid-membership; scope: security. 501(c)(3) focused on leadership/career development for minority and women cybersecurity professionals. Membership application portal; exact price not shown on the page checked. No public Discord/Slack/forum found on the official site.

name: LGBTQ in Technology Slack
notes: Affinity: lgbtq; org: LGBTQ in Technology; join: request-form; scope: tech-with-security-channel. General LGBTQ+ tech professional Slack (welcomes newcomers, career-focused, hundreds of channels including presumably infosec topic channels, though a dedicated security channel could not be directly confirmed from the homepage). Join by filling out a signup form on the site; a moderator sends the Slack invite. Large, long-running (est. ~2014) community, not a single-purpose security space, so scope is tech-with-security-channel rather than security.

name: Out in Tech Discord
notes: Affinity: lgbtq; org: Out in Tech; join: free-signup; scope: tech-with-security-channel. Out in Tech recently (2026) migrated its 37,000+ member community to Discord (per their own social post) but does not publish the raw discord.gg invite link on the public site; joining goes through the outintech.com/join flow (previously bit.ly/joinOIT, which redirects there). Broad queer-in-tech career community, not security-specific, but welcomes security professionals/newcomers and is tech-career focused, so scope=tech-with-security-channel.

name: VeteranSec
notes: Affinity: veterans; org: VeteranSec; join: request-form; scope: security. Small private Slack of cybersecurity veterans at all career stages; you must fill out a contact form (name, email, military branch, LinkedIn, background) and they send a Slack invite. Open to current/former military of any country working in cybersecurity. Distinct organization from VetSec (vetsec.org) despite the similar name.

name: Operation Code
notes: Affinity: veterans; org: Operation Code; join: free-signup; scope: tech-with-security-channel. Largest community of military veterans, service members, and spouses (plus allied SIV refugees) becoming software developers, with mentors and scholarships. General software-dev/tech-career focus rather than security-specific, though members include those on security tracks; free signup with email/name/zip grants a Slack invite.

name: TechVets
notes: Affinity: veterans; org: TechVets (Forces Employment Charity); join: open-link; scope: security. UK charity bridging veterans, service leavers, reservists, and military spouses/partners into IT and cyber careers; runs an active Discord community (confirmed to exist via Wikipedia and their own site copy) plus 12 local UK chapters. techvets.co blocks automated fetching (403), so the exact discord.gg invite URL could not be directly verified -- the community landing page above is the entry point. Worth a human follow-up to grab the live invite link.

name: Neurodiverse Hackers
notes: Affinity: neurodivergent; org: Neurodiverse Hackers (ndhack.org); join: free-signup; scope: security. 501(c)(3) nonprofit centering neurodivergent practitioners in cybersecurity; site confirms an always-on Discord ('read the rules, drop an introduction, you're in') and annual DEF CON meetup, but the exact discord.gg invite link is not exposed on the page (site returns 403 to automated fetch; text-proxy fetch also did not surface the raw invite URL). Direct the user to ndhack.org/community to get the current link.

name: Sober in Cyber
notes: Affinity: other; org: Sober in Cyber; join: open-link; scope: security. Community of sober/alcohol-free cybersecurity professionals; not on the original affinity list (neurodivergent/disability/mental-health) but adjacent mental-health/recovery focus in security, flagging as 'other'. Discord reserved for sober/alcohol-free people working in infosec; monthly 'Happiest Hour' virtual meetup.

name: DEF CON Hackers with Disabilities (HDA)
notes: Affinity: disability; org: DEF CON community group; join: open-link; scope: security. DEF CON-recognized community group focused on making DEF CON (and hacking generally) accessible to people with disabilities. Discord link found via search snippet referencing their official Twitter bio; was not independently re-verified by direct fetch of a defcon.org page, so confidence is 'listing' rather than 'official' -- recommend a human spot-check before publishing.

name: CyberPatriot Discord
notes: Affinity: youth; org: CyberPatriot (Air & Space Forces Association); join: open-link; scope: security. Official community for the CyberPatriot National Youth Cyber Defense Competition (competitors, coaches, mentors); ~6,900 members. There is also a large unofficial competitor-run server ('Cypat Community', top.gg/discord/servers/711017888541081600) but I could not confirm its exact discord.gg invite text, so it is omitted rather than guessed.

name: CyberStart Community Discord
notes: Affinity: youth; org: National Cyber Scholarship Foundation (CyberStart America / Cyber FastTrack / CyberStart Canada); join: open-link; scope: security. Supports participants of CyberStart America, Cyber FastTrack, and CyberStart Canada; open to beginners and experienced students alike (~480 members). Found via disforge.com listing, not the official nationalcyberscholarship.org site, so marked as listing confidence.

name: Cyber Discovery Community
notes: Affinity: youth; org: Alumni of NCSC/HMG's Cyber Discovery programme (unofficial, alumni-run); join: open-link; scope: security. ~4,000 members who took part in the UK's Cyber Discovery programme (2017-2021, the precursor to today's Cyber Explorers). Now skews ages 18-26 (alumni), but is the closest active public community tied to a UK youth cyber pipeline program; open to the public via the site's Join Server button, though full channel access needs a moderator to verify.

name: Girls Who Code Discord
notes: Affinity: youth, women; org: Girls Who Code; join: open-link; scope: tech-with-security-channel. Alumni/18+ community for girls and non-binary people in tech to stay connected after GWC programs; general computer science focus, not security-specific, so scope=tech-with-security-channel. The discord.me page returned 403 on fetch so I could not confirm the underlying discord.gg link directly (discord.me pages are normally redirectors to the real invite) -- confidence downgraded to guess.

name: Cybersecurity Club (Dark Marc)
notes: Affinity: career-changers; org: Cybersecurity Club; join: open-link; scope: security. Beginner/career-switcher-focused general cybersecurity Discord (~1500 members), explicitly welcomes professionals transitioning from IT/other technical or non-technical fields into cybersecurity; run by newsletter author 'Dark Marc' (cybersecurityclub.substack.com). Invite link surfaced via search results/LinkedIn post, not independently opened, so confidence is 'listing' not 'official'.

name: WOMCY - Latam Women in Cybersecurity
notes: Affinity: women; org: WOMCY; join: paid-membership; scope: security. Membership platform, not a chat community. CyberEdu tier is free-with-$1-min-donation for students (proof of enrollment required); CyberMaster $25/yr, CyberNinja $50/yr for others.

name: CryptoHarlem
notes: Affinity: bipoc; org: CryptoHarlem; join: open-link; scope: security. Digital-security/surveillance-self-defense education nonprofit for the Black community; weekly Saturday livestream discussed in Discord.

name: BlackGirlsHack (Microsoft Teams membership)
notes: Affinity: women, bipoc; org: BlackGirlsHack / BGH Foundation; join: request-form; scope: security. SAME ORG already listed on Discord (discord.gg/gCQ8Hu2CQ7) — flagging because the org's actual formal membership process now runs through Microsoft Teams via this application form, a different platform than the existing Discord listing. Applications reportedly only processed on Sundays.

name: WiCyS (Women in Cybersecurity)
notes: Affinity: women; org: WiCyS; join: paid-membership; scope: security. Large national/global nonprofit; membership grants access to a members-only community portal (womenincybersecuritywicys.my.site.com) with special interest groups. Exact fee tiers not visible in fetched text (referenced as an image 'fee chart'); likely has a reduced/free student tier but unconfirmed.

name: WISP (Women in Security and Privacy)
notes: Affinity: women; org: WISP; join: free-signup; scope: security. Site explicitly states 'no membership fees to join' and 'all are welcome.' No Slack/Discord found — the /connect page is the entry point (direct fetch of that page 404'd for us, but it was referenced from the homepage and in search results).
